name: Camping Franzlhof
beschreibung: The Camping Franzlhof is located in Söll in the federal state of Tirol and is designated as a campsite. It is situated on the outskirts of Söll and is surrounded by meadows and forests. The site offers spacious pitches for motorhomes and tents. Hiking trails and cross-country ski trails are directly accessible from the site. The farmstead has an outdoor dining area, where dishes from Tirol are served. The sanitary facilities were only recently renovated and meet modern standards.
